editorial:
Imagine growing up with your two best friends and promising to always have each other's backs. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow these three guys as they climb the ranks of the Hong Kong Triads, trading their innocence for power and money. The vibe is gritty and intense, showing you how quickly loyalty can vanish when there is only one seat at the top of the mountain. It feels like a ride through the dark side of the city where every handshake might be a lie.

You will love how the tension builds between the friends, making you wonder who will betray whom first. The acting is solid, and the action scenes hit hard, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you enjoy stories about crime and broken friendships, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the city shots. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great move for those crisp visuals.
endingExplained: The story ends in a sad way because the fight for power destroys the friendship completely. After a series of betrayals, the friends end up facing each other in a final, violent showdown. Only one man survives to take the lead of the gang, but he wins nothing in the end. He gets the title he wanted, but he is left totally alone after losing the only people he ever truly loved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas about loyalty and power.
